steps.title: Define transfer volume ranges
steps.instruction: The protocol can transfer DNA volumes of 1–20 µL and TE volumes of 20–200 µL into Plate 2.

steps.title: Load TE into trough
steps.instruction: Load TE into a single‑well trough placed on deck position 8, using a volume slightly higher than required for DNA dilution.

steps.title: Load plates onto deck
steps.instruction: Place the input Plate 1 into deck position 6 and an empty output Plate 2 into deck position 9.

steps.title: Load pipette tips
steps.instruction: Load 200 µL filter tips for the P300 pipette onto deck position 7 and 20 µL filter tips for the P20 pipette onto deck position 5.

steps.title: Execute protocol
steps.instruction: Start the Opentrons run to perform the DNA dilution according to the .csv file.
